draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Majorda! This small Salcete village north-west of Margao is famous for its beaches. Among its notable people is the Bollywood music composer Anthony Gonsalves.
draft.hungryLine: No eateries in my notes for Majorda, so ask around for the day's fresh fish.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Christ Rei Chapel is a 9 minute walk, and the parish Mother of God Church is about 19 minutes away.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Head to the beach, it's what Majorda is famous for.
moodReplies.surprise-me: Majorda has a literacy rate of 93.23%, well above Goa's average of 88.70%.

tips.title: Come by train.
tips.body: Majorda Junction is a small two-platform station near the village.

tips.title: Dress modestly at church.
tips.body: The village is dotted with chapels and its parish church, so cover up when you step inside.

story.title: A composer's village
story.body: Bollywood music composer Anthony Gonsalves, who lived from 1927 to 2012, is counted among Majorda's notable people.

story.title: A small, bookish village
story.body: The 2011 census counted 2,813 people in Majorda, with a literacy rate of 93.23%.

story.title: Hollywood comes to the beach
story.body: Planet Hollywood Beach Resort opened in December 2014, India's first Hollywood-themed beach resort.

story.title: Beaches and chapels
story.body: Majorda is still best known for its beaches, with the Mother of God Church as its parish church.
